name_reason: Name is correct and convention-compliant. Prefix data_fd2_ is the game-data convention. The trailing _37 is the dispatch index 0x37 in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (a meaningful domain id, not a Ghidra address residue: the owning function is fd2_chapter_event_handler_37__ch25_first_time), confirmed by the identical sibling pattern data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_33_drop_entry_inline at chevt2.c:175. 'drop_entry_inline' accurately reflects the datatype: a 3-byte inline battle-drop entry record (byte type + ushort value) embedded next to the handler. No hex address suffix present.
purpose: Inline const 3-byte battle-drop entry for ch25 lord-only first-time tile trigger; copied into a stack local and passed to fd2_process_battle_drop_entries to grant the lord (char 0) the drop after killing target char 0x11.
logic_summary: Read-only initializer { 0x00, 0x0B, 0x00 }. Sole reader fd2_chapter_event_handler_37__ch25_first_time @ 0x353DA copies all 3 bytes into a local array then forwards it as the entry_array_ptr arg of fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(recipient=char 0, count=1, &entry). The drop processor decodes each 3-byte entry as { byte type; ushort value }: type=0x00 selects the ITEM path, value=0x000b is item id 0x0B = 炎龍劍 (strongest blade weapon), shown via the 'you got X' dialog and added to the recipient's inventory (with full-inventory swap flow if needed).
datatype: const unsigned char[3] (battle-drop entry: byte type + little-endian ushort value)
element_semantics: [0] = drop entry type byte (0x00 = ITEM). [1..2] = little-endian ushort value = 0x000b. For type 0 (ITEM) the value is the item id (0x0B = 炎龍劍).
comment_original_issue: Source comment was already accurate (3-byte entry, type=0 ITEM, value=0x0B -> item id 11) but did not name the dropped item, unlike the sibling _33 comment which names its item.
notes: is_const=true verified: only READ (0x353f0) and DATA (0x353eb) xrefs from the single handler, zero game-side write-xref. Memory @ 0x5274b confirmed bytes 00 0b 00. Drop-entry 3-byte format (byte type + ushort value) confirmed by decompiling fd2_process_battle_drop_entries @ 0x1aa1d. Item 0x0B = 炎龍劍 confirmed via fd2-knowledge item lookup. The adjacent bytes at 0x5274e ({1d 2b 33 3d 47}) are a separate global (data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_3a_pickup_item_id_table_inline), not part of this entry.
